a.lede: In a Saturday morning post, Microsoft's CEO wrote that it’s time “to step back and assess the trust architecture” of AI.
a.title: Microsoft’s Satya Nadella says AI models need an ‘emergency brake’

b.lede: Microsoft president Brad Smith calls for urgent AI regulation, saying milk and washing machines have more oversight than AI companies.
b.title: Microsoft president says UK is best placed to drive AI regulation
